label: Upload Slot
description: Let a page's visitor upload one file of any size straight to storage. Emits `slot`, a plain string to hand the page: the page sends the file with `uploadFile(slot, file)` from `@weft/connect` (in parts, resuming after a dropped connection, never through a route), then calls a Route with the slot in a field declared as a file type (`{ video: "weft-upload:..." }`), and that Route receives the stored file. A slot uploads one file, received once, and works for `minutes`: an upload nobody received by then goes. No Keep File is needed afterwards.

inputs.name: maxMb
inputs.label: Largest file (MB)
inputs.description: The most the file may weigh, in megabytes (1 MB = 1048576 bytes); a bigger one is refused before anything is sent.

inputs.name: types
inputs.label: Accepts
inputs.description: The file type the upload must be, written as a weft type: `Video`, `Image | Video`, `Audio`, `File` for any. Checked against the file's first bytes once it landed.

inputs.name: minutes
inputs.label: Works for (minutes)
inputs.description: How long the slot works, from now: the upload and the Route receiving it both happen before it ends. At most 7 days (10080).

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Store in
inputs.description: `project`: deleted with the project. `instance`: this run's instance's files, deleted by hand, at a deadline, or with the project. `run`: the run that receives it, deleted with that run (once its record goes). Any run can read it either way.

inputs.name: ttlDays
inputs.label: Deadline (idle days, empty or 0 = none)
inputs.description: The received file is deleted once nobody has touched it for this many days, or with its run or project if that comes first. Empty or 0: no deadline, it lives as long as its scope says.

outputs.name: slot
outputs.description: The slot (`weft-upload:...`), safe to hand to the page.
